On August 18, 2025, the [Texas measles outbreak was declared over](https://www.dshs.texas.gov/news-alerts/texas-announces-end-west-texas-measles-outbreak), having comprised 762 confirmed cases, 99 hospitalizations, and a second measles-associated death.
